events.body:
## Context

CONTRIBUTING says to fork on GitHub and clone `github.com/<you>/BLT-Rewards.git`. The root README says to clone `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git` and that GitHub is a read-only mirror.

## What to do

1. Rewrite the steps: clone BLT.git, `cd BLT/blt-rewards`, open the PR on git.owaspblt.org.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No GitHub fork steps
- [ ] Commands match the root README

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the steps.
```

---
Size: **S** · good first issue. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
